scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' INT TERM; npm run dev -w @behaverse/studyflow-modeler & npm run dev -w @behaverse/studyflow-runner & wait
scripts.dev:lan: trap 'kill 0' INT TERM; npm run dev -w @behaverse/studyflow-modeler -- --host & npm run dev -w @behaverse/studyflow-runner & wait
scripts.build: npm run build -w @behaverse/studyflow-modeler && npm run build -w @behaverse/studyflow-runner
scripts.lint:schemas: playwright test --config playwright.unit.config.ts schemas.unit catalog.unit schema-model.unit schema-primitives.unit
scripts.examples:render: npm run build -w @behaverse/studyflow-cli && for f in assets/schemas/examples/*/*.studyflow.png; do node packages/cli/dist/studyflow.mjs convert --modeler "$f" "$f" || exit 1; done
